text:
finance: FYI — new billing policy: soft overage cap + configurable rate-limit cushion. Goal: fewer surprise bills and clearer throttling behavior. Details below.

marco-platform: quick clarity — what's a "rate-limit cushion"?

finance: it's a configurable buffer that allows short bursts above an org's rate limit for up to X seconds before counting toward overage. Default cushion: 30s per minute of sustained bursts.

jana-support: will customers see this in Console? they ask for predictable behavior.

finance: yes 1 — Console will show the cushion value and a live "burst budget" meter. Also we'll surface an "estimated overage" card on the billing tab when cushion drains.

tara-product: does the soft cap change invoicing math? customers hate hidden fees.

finance: soft overage cap means we will automatically cap invoice overage charges for small accounts at $50/month by default (configurable). Above that, normal billing applies. This is meant for small orgs only; enterprise/custom plans opt out.

billing-bot: ROLLOUT TIMELINE:
- Day 0: Announcement
- Day 5: Console UI + API preview
- Day 20: Soft cap enforcement live for qualifying orgs

marco-platform: SDK change needed? we should include header `x-rw-burst-id` to correlate bursts.

finance: good idea. We'll add `x-rw-burst-id` optional header and include server-side heuristics for older clients.

jana-support: prepare FAQ: "why was I throttled but not charged?" and "how to disable cushion".

finance: on it. Drafts go to /docs/billing/soft-overage-cushion.md. End.
